baseline.source: Original procedural modules recovered from the prior SHUORI 1.2.0 release, before licensing extraction.

content.publicationNote: The original equivalence comparison predates publication metadata edits and neutralized display labels. Geometry, materials, transforms, coordinates and all 590 stable object IDs remain unchanged; copyright/source/license metadata, the independent-demo disclaimer and generic Library/Hospital school labels are publication-only changes.

comparisons.allVertexPositionBuffers: Exact array equality for every mesh
comparisons.allGeometryAttributesAndIndices: Exact SHA-256 equality of complete attribute arrays, item sizes, normalization flags and indices for every mesh
comparisons.allMaterialDefinitions: Exact SHA-256 equality of material JSON excluding per-instance UUIDs for every mesh
comparisons.registryAndMetadata: Exact equality of every original object ID and metadata, floors, zones and labels
comparisons.floorIsolation: All eight floors preserve their original registry counts and floor-local parent, position, rotation and facade membership
comparisons.explodedView: Floor spacing changes to 14 units; connectors resize to 100 units; individual-floor connectors remain absent
comparisons.coordinates: Operational coordinate mappings and floor override precedence preserved
